description.p: A small GTK4 / libadwaita dashboard that lists your Claude Code, pi and OpenCode sessions together, newest first, showing each session's title, agent and working directory.

ul.li: Filter the list to one agent
Search across session titles, working directories, and conversation content, forgiving typos
Resume any session in your default terminal with one click
Start a new named session in any directory, creating a folder from the name
Open a session's working directory in your file manager
See and set the session colour set by /color
Star sessions to keep them in a Favorites section
Rename sessions, or delete ones you no longer need (moved to the trash)

description.p: Renamed from Claude Code Sessions to Pickup, and lists pi and OpenCode sessions alongside Claude Code ones.
